title: Interview-slot booking for a small team
summary: A booking page where candidates pick an interview slot from interviewers' availability, across time zones, with no double-booking and a clean cancellation.
context: Bramble Works is a fictional 12-person start-up that interviews candidates in India, Singapore and Berlin. Today the recruiter trades e-mails to find a time and sometimes books two people into one slot.

You build the app. Interviewers publish availability, a candidate opens a link and picks a slot shown in their own time zone, and the system books it. Two candidates clicking the same slot at the same moment must not both get it.
Keep scope small and correctness high. There is no calendar integration and nothing is e-mailed; the app shows what it would send.
must_have: Interviewers set weekly availability in their own time zone; the candidate page lists bookable slots in the candidate's zone, with the zone named on screen.
Atomic booking: simultaneous requests for one slot produce exactly one booking, proved by a test.
Tests for a daylight-saving change in a zone that has one, and for a half-hour-offset zone such as India.
Cancel and reschedule through a private, unguessable link, freeing the slot, with a cutoff (say 4 hours before) that is enforced.
A 'would send' log with the text of each confirmation and cancellation message, never sent.
nice_to_have: Panel interviews that need two interviewers free at once.
Buffer time between interviews and a daily cap per interviewer.
A downloadable .ics file for each booking.
constraints: No paid services, APIs or accounts, and no calendar or e-mail provider.
Fictional data only: made-up people, example.com addresses.
deliverables: A public repo created after you press Start, with commits spread across the window.
A README with how to run and seed the app, how to run the tests, and what is missing.
judge_focus: How double-booking is prevented, and what the database guarantees rather than what the code hopes.
Time-zone decisions: what is stored, and tests on the awkward cases.
What the person who loses the race is told.
A trail of commits: the data model and its tests first, screens after.
bengaluru_context: Teams building recruiting, scheduling and HR-tech products in Bengaluru, and any engineering team that runs its own hiring across time zones, solve this every quarter.
